completion_gate: specification.yaml exists, is marked approved, and contains: measured quantity, ell grid, sample sizes, controls C-NULL/C-INSTR/C-BASE/C-ALT, stopping rules, required artifacts, the pre-registered gamma fit and c extrapolation law, and an explicit non-claims section.
source_record.yaml records the PoC provenance and the SageMath-unavailable fact.
The opening report records the Section 8 proof_search_map applicability determination.
constraints: The contract is frozen: it is written before the Executor runs and is not revised in light of results. A needed change is a superseding contract under a new id, never an edit.

State the measured quantity exactly: cost(ell) = (F_{p^2} multiplications to instantiate Phi_ell(j, x) at a sampled supersingular j) + (F_{p^2} multiplications to find all its roots in F_{p^2}); entries(ell) = number of distinct non-backtracking ell-neighbours obtained; per_entry(ell) = cost(ell)/entries(ell). Counting unit is the F_{p^2} multiplication, because that is the unit paper Section 4.1 costs at 1 per entry.

PRE-REGISTER the fit and the extrapolation law before any datum: log2 per_entry(ell) = gamma * log2(ell) + const over a declared ell grid; the map to the EXP-P13VOW-001 overhead knob is c = gamma * log2(B_opt) / sqrt(log2 p), with B_opt taken from RUN-P13VOW-001's recorded optima. Declare the grid, the sample size per ell, and the acceptance band for gamma in the contract, not afterwards.

REQUIRE these controls, per docs/inventor-protocol.md 'controls before belief': (C-NULL) a null object of the same shape - run the identical counting harness over a construction whose per-entry cost is O(1) by construction (fixed ell = 2 walk steps) and require the instrument to report gamma ~ 0 there; a counter that reports growth on the null object is an instrument artifact and voids the measurement. (C-INSTR) instrument fidelity on a case with an exactly known count, e.g. a schoolbook product of two degree-d polynomials over F_{p^2} must count exactly (d+1)^2 multiplications. (C-BASE) baseline reproduction: the re-implemented table build must agree with the frozen PoC's own count() estimator for small (B, X), and any isogeny chain reported must satisfy Phi_ell(j_i, j_{i+1}) = 0 at every step, verified independently of the code that produced it. (C-ALT) at least two independent root-finding implementations, so gamma is a property of the problem and not of one implementation; if they disagree, both are reported and the SMALLER per-entry cost is carried forward, because the attack-favourable corner is the honest one to hand the attacker.

Declare the modular-polynomial provenance rule: Phi_ell must come from a recorded primary source with a fetch URL and SHA-256, or be computed in-repo by a method stated in the contract. Which route was used is recorded per run. If neither is obtainable inside budget, that is a recorded fetch obstruction, not a result.

Declare stopping rules and the meaning of exhaustion: a truncated ell grid yields a gamma confidence interval over the range actually reached and is scoped evidence; a timeout, crash, or missing dependency is an infrastructure outcome and never mathematical evidence about the attack (AGENTS.md rule 5).

Declare the non-claims explicitly in the contract: this measures a toy-scale exponent at p ~ 2^40 over a small ell range; any statement about NIST-I is an extrapolation under the pre-registered law and must be reported as conditional, never as a measurement of a cryptographic-scale margin.

Also write inputs/P13-PANNY-POC/source_record.yaml recording the PoC's URL, fetch date, byte length, SHA-256, upstream Last-Modified, its stated SageMath dependency, and the plain fact that SageMath is NOT installed in this environment - so the PoC serves as a frozen algorithmic reference for the re-implementation, not as the executed program. Do not editorialize the frozen file and do not modify it.

Assess whether docs/inventor-protocol.md Section 8 requires a proof_search_map here. This control is a measurement, not a proof-oriented proposal; if you conclude no map is required, record that conclusion and its reason in the opening report rather than silently omitting it.
Only the Coordinator may approve an experiment. This task approves EXP-PEC-6be870 for execution; it changes no hypothesis status and asserts no result.
deliverables: opening_report.md stating the batch objective, the pre-registered fit and extrapolation law, the control set, and the Section 8 applicability determination
handoff.objective: Freeze, before any datum is produced, the complete experiment contract for red-team next-control NC-2: measure the true per-entry cost of Algorithm 1's table construction in F_{p^2}-operations at p ~ 2^40, as a function of the isogeny degree ell and hence of the smoothness bound B, and state the extrapolation law that carries a measured exponent to the overhead parameter c of EXP-P13VOW-001 BEFORE any measurement is taken.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the deciding measurement for the NIST-I concrete question is specified tightly enough - controls, metrics, stopping rules, artifacts, and pre-registered extrapolation law - that its result cannot be reinterpreted after the fact.

dispatches.title: Freeze the NC-2 experiment contract EXP-PEC-6be870 and the Panny PoC source

objective: GOAL-P13-001 BATCH-002 executes red-team next-control NC-2 (DEC-20260724-016), the single deciding measurement for the concrete NIST-I question left INCONCLUSIVE by BATCH-001: the true per-entry cost of Algorithm 1's table construction, which paper Section 4.1 assumes to be exactly one F_{p^2}-operation. The batch freezes an experiment contract (EXP-PEC-6be870) and the Panny proof-of-concept source named by NC-2, runs one bounded Executor measurement at p ~ 2^40 with pre-registered null-object and instrument-fidelity controls, and closes with independent Validator and Red Team review before a ledger archive. The batch measures a toy-scale exponent and states an explicit extrapolation law; it does not claim a cryptographic-scale result and does not by itself promote or reject H-P13-001.
